articles.title: Verstappen seals commanding Singapore victory
articles.description: Red Bull's Max Verstappen continued his winning form by triumphing in the Singapore Grand Prix on his 250th Grand Prix start.

articles.title: What the teams said – Race day in Singapore
articles.description: The drivers and teams report back on all the action from the 2026 Singapore Grand Prix.

articles.title: All the key moments from the 2026 Singapore Grand Prix
articles.description: Max Verstappen continued his 2026 resurgence in Singapore, beating Charles Leclerc and Kimi Antonelli to a long-awaited Grand Prix victory around Marina Bay.

articles.title: Hamilton apologises after ‘painful lesson’ in Singapore
articles.description: Lewis Hamilton has conceded that the decision to stay out on track rather than pit under the Virtual Safety Car during the Singapore Grand Prix was his, labelling it as a "painful lesson".

articles.title: ‘It was a mistake’ – Vasseur on Hamilton’s strategy call
articles.description: Ferrari Team Principal Fred Vasseur has explained how a podium finish slipped out of Lewis Hamilton’s hands at the Singapore Grand Prix.

articles.title: Russell rues ‘difficult’ Singapore GP as ‘story of season’
articles.description: Mercedes' George Russell faced a challenging drive at the Singapore Grand Prix, having climbed through the order from P19 to P9.

articles.title: Antonelli reacts as Singapore P3 puts him on brink of title
articles.description: Kimi Antonelli amusingly appeared to be taken by surprise when informed that his podium finish in the Singapore Grand Prix has put him on the brink of clinching this year’s World Championship title.

articles.title: Norris 'not happy with a P4' finish in Singapore GP
articles.description: Lando Norris admits that he is "not happy with a P4" finish in the Singapore Grand Prix, with the reigning World Champion demanding more from McLaren as they "want to fight for wins".

articles.title: Leclerc ‘gave it all’ to secure P2 in Singapore
articles.description: Charles Leclerc has reflected on his return to the podium at the Singapore Grand Prix.
